headline: Shell Converts 1.23 Billion Raizen Ordinary Shares to Preferred Shares
summary: Shell converted 1.23 billion ordinary shares of Raizen into preferred shares, reducing its voting share stake from 50 percent to 42.05 percent while raising its preferred share stake to 50 percent.
why: Major equity restructuring by strategic shareholders can alter voting control, liquidity profiles, and corporate governance structures within publicly traded energy companies.

impacts.name: Raizen
impacts.why: Conversion of share classes alters ownership structure and voting power distribution.
